status: Closed — fixed in a58206070; task import now warns on projection-only atom-map scope
finding: A task card can list `atomic_workbench/atomization-coverage/path-to-atom-map.json` as a deliverable while the validator treats owner shards as the source of truth; editing only the projection makes `validate:atomization-coverage` fail with a shard-merge mismatch.
expectedBehavior: Task cards that require atom-map updates should name the owner shard path or provide a governed projection rebuild lane; `next`/import should warn when only the generated projection is scoped.
evidenceOrRepro: During TASK-AAO-0158, updating only `path-to-atom-map.json` produced `projection mappings=165, merged shards=161` and remediation `path-to-atom-map-shards/merge.js <repo> write-projection`; the change was reverted because the claimed scope did not include shard files. Fixed in `a58206070`: task import emits `ATM_TASK_IMPORT_GENERATED_ATOM_MAP_PROJECTION_ONLY` when the generated projection is scoped without an owner shard, and the warning includes the governed rebuild command. Regression `tests/cli/task-import-atom-map-projection-warning.test.ts` passed; `npx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit`, encoding guard, and `git diff --check` passed.
followUp: For future atom-map changes, scope the owner shard (or its governed shard glob) and rebuild the projection through `node atomic_workbench/atomization-coverage/path-to-atom-map-shards/merge.js <repo> write-projection`.
